title: Check Fleet-Level AGV Status on “Overall System AGV Status” (Top: all AGVs, Bottom: AGVs with errors)
summary: Use the RMS / fleet status UI screen labeled “Overall System AGV Status” to review fleet-level AGV information. Confirm the Top Section lists all AGVs with columns for ID, Status, Destination, and Errors, then use the Bottom Section (“Only AGVs with errors”) to identify which AGVs currently have errors.
when_to_use: When you need a fleet-level view of AGV status and to quickly identify which AGVs currently show errors using the “Overall System AGV Status” screen’s two sections (Top: all AGVs; Bottom: only AGVs with errors).
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the RMS / fleet status UI checks on the “Overall System AGV Status” screen and report any mismatch between the Top Section Errors and the Bottom Section filtered list.

visual_references.description: Training video frame showing the “Overall System AGV Status” layout: Top Section (“Detailed info for all AGVs” with columns including ID, Status, Destination, Errors) and Bottom Section (“Only AGVs with errors”).

steps.title: Open the RMS / fleet status UI and navigate to “Overall System AGV Status”
steps.purpose: Get to the correct fleet-level AGV status screen that contains both the full AGV list and the errors-only filtered list.
steps.instruction: Using the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui), open the screen labeled “Overall System AGV Status”.
steps.expected_result: The “Overall System AGV Status” screen loads and shows two sections: a Top Section for detailed info for all AGVs and a Bottom Section labeled for AGVs with errors.
steps.healthy_condition: The screen is not blank and displays AGV rows in the Top Section and the Bottom Section area.
steps.failure_condition: The screen does not load or appears blank (no AGV rows).

actions.label: Verify screen loaded
actions.exact_action: Open the RMS / fleet status UI and navigate to the screen labeled “Overall System AGV Status”.

stop_or_escalate_if: The RMS/fleet status UI is blank/unreachable when attempting to open the screen.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text shows “Overall System AGV Status” with a Top Section for detailed info for all AGVs (ID, Status, Destination, Errors) and a Bottom Section for only AGVs with errors.
Transcript/OCR near 02:09:34.500 references switching to a new section and shows the “Overall System AGV Status” layout (Top: all AGVs; Bottom: only AGVs with errors).

steps.title: Confirm Top Section columns include ID, Status, Destination, and Errors
steps.purpose: Ensure the Top Section is showing the expected fleet-level fields needed to compare against the errors-only list.
steps.instruction: In the Top Section (“Detailed info for all AGVs”), confirm the table/fields shown include: AGV ID, Status, Destination, and Errors.
steps.expected_result: The Top Section displays columns/fields labeled for ID, Status, Destination, and Errors.
steps.healthy_condition: The Top Section clearly shows the expected column labels/fields (ID, Status, Destination, Errors) for the AGV rows.
steps.failure_condition: The Top Section does not show the expected fields/columns (ID, Status, Destination, Errors).

actions.label: Check column labels
actions.exact_action: In the Top Section (“Detailed info for all AGVs”), confirm the table/fields shown include: AGV ID, Status, Destination, and Errors.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text shows “Overall System AGV Status” with a Top Section for detailed info for all AGVs (ID, Status, Destination, Errors).
OCR text includes: “Top Section: Detailed info for all AGVs - ID, - Status, Destination, and Errors”.

steps.title: Scan Top Section rows for non-empty Errors values
steps.purpose: Identify which AGVs have errors according to the Top Section Errors column.
steps.instruction: Scan the Top Section rows and observe which AGVs have non-empty values in the Errors column.
steps.expected_result: At least one AGV row shows a non-empty Errors value (if any errors are present in the fleet view).
steps.healthy_condition: You can distinguish AGVs with and without errors by the presence/absence of values in the Errors column.
steps.failure_condition: No AGVs show errors in the Errors column when you expect errors (based on the Bottom Section behavior), or the Errors column cannot be interpreted due to missing/blank values.

actions.label: Check Errors column
actions.exact_action: Scan the Top Section rows to observe which AGVs are currently in which Status and whether any Errors are present in the Errors column.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text indicates the Top Section includes an Errors column for all AGVs.

steps.title: Inspect Bottom Section “Only AGVs with errors” and confirm it is filtered
steps.purpose: Use the errors-only filtered list to identify the specific AGVs currently in an error state.
steps.instruction: Scroll/inspect the Bottom Section labeled “Only AGVs with errors” and confirm it lists only AGVs that have errors.
steps.expected_result: The Bottom Section shows only AGVs with errors (i.e., the list is filtered to error-bearing AGVs).
steps.healthy_condition: Every AGV shown in the Bottom Section corresponds to an AGV with a non-empty Errors value in the Top Section.
steps.failure_condition: The Bottom Section is unexpectedly empty while the Top Section shows multiple AGVs with non-empty Errors, or the Bottom Section does not reflect the Top Section Errors.

actions.label: Verify filtered list
actions.exact_action: Scroll/inspect the Bottom Section (“Only AGVs with errors”) and confirm it is filtered to only AGVs that have errors.

stop_or_escalate_if: Bottom Section is unexpectedly empty while the Top Section shows multiple AGVs with non-empty Errors.
The Bottom Section does not reflect the Errors shown in the Top Section (e.g., errors exist but bottom list is empty).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text shows “Bottom Section: Only AGVs with errors”.
Transcript/OCR near 02:09:34.500 references switching to a new section and shows the “Overall System AGV Status” layout (Top: all AGVs; Bottom: only AGVs with errors).

success_criteria: Top Section shows columns/fields for ID, Status, Destination, and Errors.
Bottom Section (“Only AGVs with errors”) is filtered to only AGVs that have non-empty Errors values in the Top Section.
If errors exist in the Top Section, the Bottom Section is not empty.
healthy_conditions: Top Section displays ID, Status, Destination, and Errors fields for all AGVs.
Bottom Section lists only AGVs with errors and matches the Top Section Errors presence.
failure_conditions: RMS/fleet status UI screen is blank/unreachable.
Bottom Section is empty while Top Section shows multiple AGVs with non-empty Errors.
Bottom Section does not reflect the Errors shown in the Top Section.
escalation_guidance: If the Bottom Section is empty while the Top Section shows multiple AGVs with non-empty Errors, or if the screen is blank/unreachable, escalate for investigation of RMS/fleet status UI filtering/refresh behavior.
